what: PROTOCOL_V3 Addendum H, synthesis_B: lead analyst for the lenses context, cluster and breadth. In sample only (entries before 2022-01-01; price frames read with ts < 2022-01-01; official trades with entry_time < 2022-01-01). No validation look.

first_check_rule2.note: 8 sleeves identical row by row; donch4h_stop and orb_asia_2d_buf10 identical except the trade entered on 2021-12-31, open at the end of the slice (excluded)

where_the_losses_come_from: Losses are full stops near -1 R, not a fat tail. Ten sleeves, entries 2018-02-01..2021-12-31, FP costs, 5,205 trades (my re-simulation): 2,864 lost (55 %), average loss -0.65 R, gross loss 1,853 R against a gross gain of 2,642 R (+788.6 R net). 1,337 losses at the initial stop made -1,358 R (73 % of the gross loss), 1,417 at the clock exit -432 R, 110 at donch4h's trailing stop -63 R. Only 16 of the 2,864 losses were worse than -1.1 R (worst -1.49 R), and the worst tenth of the losing trades makes 16 % of the gross loss: there is no 'one big loss' beyond the stop.

Sleeve by sleeve the size of a loss is set by the rule's stop and clock (same window, FP): orb_asia gold -0.99 R per losing trade (319 losers, 94 % of them full stops, 98 % of its gross loss); ocm4 -0.90 R (291; 83 %, 93 %); brk72 and F1 on btc and eth -0.73 to -0.74 R (260-300 losers each; 55-61 % full stops, 76-84 % of the gross loss); donch4h -0.59 R (115, mostly the trailing stop); noise30 -0.44 R (481, 405 at its band or clock exit); nq_btc_follow -0.37 R (451, 377 at its 60-minute clock); GOLD_FRI_PM -0.16 R (96, never stopped), and flat overall: -0.007 R per trade, -1.3 R on 183 trades.

The gains come from a few large winners: the best 5 % of the trades carry 144 % of the ten sleeves' total R (orb gold 548 %, ocm4 196 %, noise30 156 %, nq 135 %, crypto breakouts 89-108 %); without them the portfolio loses. The median winner peaks at +1.2 R and closes at +0.65 R.

The user's first claim does not hold on these rules: cutting at once a trade that starts hard the wrong way loses money. 19 % of the winners (about 440 trades, 2018-02..2021-12, FP) first went at least 0.5 R against them; together they made +577 R, 73 % of the ten sleeves' total (ocm4: 37 % of its winners, +89 R; orb gold: 40 %, +106 R; F1 btc: 26 %, +97 R). The quick check (all in-sample years, 7,965 trades, FP): closing a trade that shows -0.25 R or worse after 5, 15, 30, 60 or 120 minutes costs 98, 231, 180, 84 and 68 R (574 to 930 trades cut, 131 to 211 future winners killed); at -0.5 R it costs 4 to 28 R; only at -0.75 R does it sometimes save a little (+1.8 to +5.0 R at 3 of 5 checkpoints, 29 to 47 trades; -3.0 and -5.0 R at the other two). The rest of a trade still earns on average in every state bucket except the deepest (below -0.75 R: -0.17 to +0.11 R on 29 to 49 trades per checkpoint) and, at 5 minutes only, the trades already 0.5 R ahead (-0.06 R on 220).

The user's second claim is already built into the rules: they let winners run to the clock exit or the trailing stop, and the earlier tracks found that taking profits sooner costs money (targets at 0.5 R kept 6-25 % of the expectancy, break-even at +1 R changed it by -36 % to +7 %) and that adding to winners gave nothing. Only 9.5 % of the losers had been 1 R ahead (22-23 % on ocm4 and orb gold). Holding winners even longer looked better on 5 of the 10 sleeves in the payoff lens's in-sample table (trades 1 R ahead held two more sessions: ocm4 +0.11 -> +0.25 R per trade, F1 eth +0.20 -> +0.41, F1 btc +0.34 -> +0.45, brk72 eth +0.21 -> +0.30, brk72 btc +0.26 -> +0.30) and worse or equal on noise30, orb gold, nq and GOLD_FRI_PM. Those are the lens's own figures before its attacks; they are judged in the other synthesis, not here.

When the signals lose (context lens, baseline trades, FP): breakouts taken just after their own volatility unit has expanded earn much less (highest vs lowest third of vol / 60-day median: brk72 btc +0.07 vs +0.62 R per trade, brk72 eth -0.06 vs +0.57, F1 btc +0.09 vs +0.77, F1 eth +0.07 vs +0.36, donch4h -0.01 vs +0.39, orb +0.13 vs +0.44), and crypto breakouts with a stop wide in % of the price lose (brk72 eth widest third -0.18 R per trade on 173 trades, negative in each year 2018-2021). Clock: nq signals at 09:30-09:46 New York -0.002 R per trade (359), noise30 checks at 12:00-15:30 -0.003 (547) against +0.10 at 10:00-10:30; Friday entries +0.08 R (1,149) against +0.16 to +0.22 on Monday-Thursday; entries after 12:00 New York +0.04 R (1,199) against +0.19 (cluster lens).

But those weak contexts are mostly less profitable, not losing, so skipping them rarely pays: in the training years the high-volatility third of the crypto breakouts still earned +0.04 to +0.33 R per signal; 69 of the 109 declared filters and models skipped nothing out of fold, and the 31 that acted lost 144.5 R together. One filter survived (the ETH stop width, K1).

Losses that come together (cluster lens): inside a sleeve a loss does not make the next one more likely (8 of 10 sleeves |z| <= 1.35; brk72 btc and eth alternate). On one market and one day they do come together (us100: 130 days with two or more red sleeves against 106 expected, p 0.0005; noise30 and ocm4 daily correlation 0.52), and bitcoin with ether correlate 0.54 per day (every other pair of markets -0.03 to +0.04). The 10 worst days (-61 R) each had 5 to 8 red sleeves on 3 to 4 markets. Yet trades opened while another sleeve held the same side of the same market earned more (+0.24 against +0.14 R), so all 29 guards failed: the best raised the expectancy by 14.7 % while lowering the total by 9.5 %.

Elsewhere (breadth lens), costs kill most transfers: 117 of 126 new rule x instrument pairs fail; 29 have a gross PF of 1.15 or more but only 10 keep it after FP costs (GOLD_FRI_PM on FX gross 1.20, net 0.81; nq on 40 shares gross 1.05, net 0.67). The strong passes are crypto trend rules (orb and donch4h on btc and eth), whose profit comes mostly from positions held over the weekend.

The edge fades with time: the ten sleeves made +0.19, +0.15, +0.21 and +0.07 R per trade in 2018, 2019, 2020 and 2021 (FP, 1,224 to 1,437 trades a year); every crypto sleeve was weakest in 2021; on 2022-2025 the ten average +0.08 R per trade (task figure, not read here).

user_claim.cut_at_once_a_trade_that_goes_hard_the_w: does not pay on these rules (see where_the_losses_come_from[3])
user_claim.let_run_the_one_that_goes_well: already done by the rules; holding winners longer looked better on 5 of 10 sleeves in the payoff lens's unattacked in-sample table (judged in the other synthesis)

kept_changes.change: K1 (context-ETH-brk72-riskbp): skip a signal when the rule's own 3 x ATR24 stop is at least T(Y) basis points of the price (riskbp = 10,000 x stop / mid price of the last bar before the decision). T is refitted every 1 January on the sleeve's earlier signals (each taken alone, FP costs, decided before 1 January minus 7 days; terciles; the losing side is skipped only if it lost): 505.9 bp in 2019, 496.7 in 2020, 465.1 in 2021, 478.3 for 2022. A skipped signal does not block the next one. Rule and parameters otherwise unchanged.
kept_changes.effect_in_sample: My re-run, identical to the author's and the verifier's, FP costs: 2019-2021 (its out-of-fold years) 395 -> 304 trades, +0.124 -> +0.210 R per trade, +49.1 -> +63.9 R (+14.8 R), win rate 43.8 -> 48.4 %, average loss -0.70 -> -0.72 R (not smaller: it removes trades, it does not shrink losses); costs x1.5 +40.9 -> +56.4 R. By year +11.2 -> +16.5, +36.2 -> +34.6, +1.7 -> +12.8 R. Whole window 2018-02..2021-12: 511 -> 420 trades, +0.209 -> +0.289 R per trade, +106.6 -> +121.4 R (2018 unchanged, no fold). 103 baseline trades removed (-20.8 R), 12 new ones (-6.0 R). Truncation test: 30 of 30 decisions identical.
kept_changes.verdict_of_the_attack: weakened. Causal; holds with costs x1.5 and x2, one-minute delays, the 3-spread rule and the weekend-gap control. But 11.1 of the 14.8 R come from 2021, whose skip exists only because 2018 is in the expanding training window (rolling windows skip nothing in 2021); the total-R gain's 90 % interval is -2 to +31 R; no null test stays below 5 % once the lens's 109 variants are counted. Verifier's remaining effect: +0.03 to +0.06 R per trade, +4 to +9 R over 2019-2021 (1.5 to 3 R a year), possibly zero.

kept_changes.verdict_of_the_attack: weakened. Causal and broad (all 15 neighbouring settings positive every year), robust to delays and costs; but the edge per trade halves from 2018-2019 (+0.695) to 2020-2021 (+0.263, t 1.7), 2021 +0.196 (t 0.9); 72 % of its R comes from trades held over the weekend; run as the current hands would (entry one minute late, everything closed Friday 16:50 New York) +0.363 R per trade, +142.1 R on 392 trades (x1.5 +0.326, +127.9 R); its excess over random timing is not significant once the 126 pairs are counted; ethusd would carry three sleeves for two slots (30 entries refused, -7.6 R). Verifier's judgement: +0.15 to +0.25 R per trade forward.

Real but fragile: 2020-2021 +0.163 R per trade (t 1.0), 2021 +0.007; at the bid/ask actually quoted in 2018-2020 (116-181 bp) only +0.05 R per trade; 19 trades make all the profit; with the hands' Friday close 2021 turns negative; weekly correlation 0.40 with the ethusd pair (largely the same bet). dropped: B3 donch4h_stop on ethusd (weakened, still positive: +0.220 R per trade, +53.2 R on 242 trades with costs x1.5, one-bar delays and the Friday close) is not carried: on ethusd the orb pair keeps the larger total-R gain after the attacks (+127.9 R under costs x1.5, late entry and the Friday close), ethusd already has two sleeves for two slots, and donch4h ethusd is largely the same bet (weekly correlation 0.49 with brk72 ethusd). For information (P3, FP): adding it too gives 6,056 trades, +0.203 R per trade, +1,226.5 R, worst week -17.2 R, drawdown 36.2 R.

B4 brk72_24h_wd on jp225: refuted. 2013-2021 +0.018 R per trade (1,151 trades, t 0.59); a one-minute entry delay drops its PF to 1.13; random-entry null at the 92nd percentile; its 10 best trades make more than its total.

B5 donch4h_stop on us100: refuted. Random timing with the same structure passes the same bar 22 % of the time; 17.7 of its 18.7 R come from 5 trades; 2013-2021 +0.028 R per trade; -2.45 bp per trade net (positive in R only).
B7 F1_brk_ridge_filter on xagusd: refuted. With the walk-forward scorecard the protocol requires: +0.030 R per trade, PF 1.08, -1.75 R with costs x1.5; the filter's lift on silver is 0.000 R.

B6 donch4h_stop jp225, B8 donch4h_stop btcusd, B9 ocm4 btcusd passed the breadth bar but were never attacked, so they cannot be kept (B8 is a near-duplicate of brk72 btcusd, weekly correlation 0.72; B9 lowers the portfolio's weekly Sharpe by 0.12).

Cluster lens: none of 29 portfolio guards and adaptive rules raised the expectancy by 20 % (common window, FP): one position per market and side -3 to -20 % per trade; pausing a sleeve after 2-5 losses -4 to -15 %; no new entry on a market after one loss that day +14.7 % per trade but -9.5 % total; weights by trailing results +3.7 to +13.1 % (mostly a fixed tilt to the best in-sample sleeves); trading a sleeve only while its trailing result is positive +0.5 to +7.6 % at a lower total; daily lock at -4 R +2.2 %; no entry the day after a day at -2 to -4 R +0.6 to +2.8 %; pausing the portfolio after 4-8 losses -0.5 to -2.5 %. Trades removed by these guards earned as much as those kept, or more.

Context lens: volatility-regime filters skipped nothing out of fold on the crypto and orb sleeves (donch4h +0.146 -> +0.226 R per trade but worse in 2018-2019 and its neighbours fail); hour-of-day filters (noise30 +14 % per trade, total 87.0 -> 84.1 R); trend alignment (orb +0.069 -> +0.027); a ridge model on 8 descriptors (F1 eth +27 % but +17.7 % with costs x1.5; orb and nq lower); a pause after the previous result (brk72 eth +86 % but 2021 worse); spread / stop on the other sleeves (brk72 btc +11 %). 330 variants, one passed (K1).

Breadth lens beyond its qualifiers: noise30 on 14 other instruments (0 pass; on FX it loses even before costs, net PF 0.72), ocm4 on 15 (1 weak, B9), GOLD_FRI_PM outside gold on 11 (0; gross 1.20 on FX, net 0.81), nq_btc_follow with 54 other followers (0; shares net PF 0.66), F1 on 12 (1, refuted), brk72 on 7 indices and metals (1, refuted), orb on 5 indices (0), donch4h on us500 and us30 (0).
The user's rule 'cut at once' (quick check): closing at -0.25 R or -0.5 R at any of five checkpoints from 5 to 120 minutes loses 4 to 231 R over 2013-2021; it does not pay on these rules.

proposed_validation_look: DECLARATION of one look at 2022-2025 (synthesis_B, written 2026-11-12 before any 2022+ row is read; run once by the lead; every read logged in results/val_access.log, track 'autopsy_synthesis_B'). FROZEN. (1) K1, brk72_24h_wd on ethusd: rule and parameters unchanged (n 72, stop 3 x ATR24, exit 24 h after the decision, weekdays UTC, FP-hours exit wrapper of r2/recalc.py, one position). A signal decided at D is skipped when riskbp = 10,000 x stop_dist / P >= T(Y), P being the mid close of the last M1 bar starting before D. T(2022) = 478.28 bp (fitted now on the 2,345 in-sample signals decided before 2021-12-25: E_hi -0.131, E_lo +0.342 R). T(2023), T(2024) and T(2025) are refitted on each 1 January by the same procedure (every signal taken alone with FP costs; signals decided before 1 January Y minus 7 days; terciles, q = 1/3; the worse side is skipped only if min(E_lo, E_hi) < 0, otherwise nothing). A skipped signal never blocks a later one. (2) K2 and K3: orb_asia_2d_buf10 with FINALISTS['orb_asia_2d_buf10'] of lab/tracks/orb/strategy.py, unchanged, as new sleeves on ethusd and on btcusd, one position each, held through weekends as specified. (3) The other nine sleeves unchanged. (4) Costs: r2.costs(sym) and the FP frames as they are today, and costs x1.5 (spread and slippage, orders rebuilt); an order whose stop is closer than 3 spreads of its fill bar is not taken. (5) Frames from their start to 2025-12-31 23:59 UTC (warm-up from in-sample bars), trades entered 2022-01-01..2025-12-31; nothing from 2026. If the other synthesis carries a change for brk72_24h_wd ethusd, only one of the two (the larger total-R gain after its attacks) enters this look, chosen before it is run. COMPARED. (a) brk72_24h_wd ethusd with the skip against the same sleeve without it (both chains re-simulated, one position), and the skipped signals taken alone against the kept ones; (b) each new sleeve on its own; (c) the ten unchanged against the ten with K1, K2 and K3, with the metrics of this synthesis (trades, R per trade, win rate, average win and loss, PF, total R, worst week, drawdown, longest losing run of weeks, mean / sd of R per trade), by year, FP and x1.5. CRITERIA, fixed now. K1 is adopted only if, on 2022-2025, the sleeve's expectancy per trade with the skip is higher than without and its total R is not lower, both with FP costs and with costs x1.5, and the skipped signals taken alone earn less on average than the kept ones. Each new sleeve is adopted only if, with FP costs, PF >= 1.06, expectancy > 0, every-signal expectancy > 0, total R positive in at least 3 of the 4 years, and expectancy > 0 with costs x1.5; and the weekly mean / sd of R of the ten plus that sleeve is at least that of the ten alone. Read beside it, for the robot as it is (not a criterion of the rule): the same sleeve with entry one minute late and every position closed on Friday at 16:50 New York; if that version has expectancy <= 0, the sleeve waits for a robot that holds it over the weekend. Expectations declared now (the verifiers' estimates, not targets): K1 +0.03 to +0.06 R per trade on about a quarter fewer ETH brk72 trades, possibly zero; orb ethusd +0.15 to +0.25 R per trade; orb btcusd +0.10 to +0.16, possibly zero. A failure is final: nothing is re-tuned, re-declared or looked at again.
summary_for_the_user_fr:
Couper tout de suite un trade qui part mal ne paie pas avec ces règles : cela fait perdre.
2018-2021 : un gagnant sur cinq a d'abord été en perte de la moitié de sa mise ; ces trades ont fait 73 % du gain.
Couper à -25 % de la mise après 5 minutes aurait coûté 98 mises sur 2013-2021.
Laisser courir les gagnants : les règles le font déjà ; 5 % des trades font plus que tout le gain.
Les pertes sont surtout des stops pleins (73 % des pertes), presque jamais plus d'une mise.
Après les contrôles, trois changements restent, tous affaiblis par les attaques.
Ether, cassure : sauter le signal si le stop dépasse environ 4,8 % du prix ; gain attendu +0,03 à +0,06 mise par trade, peut-être zéro.
La règle « Asie » de l'or ajoutée sur ether et bitcoin : forte en 2018-2019, faible en 2020-2021, bitcoin nul en 2021.
Portefeuille 2018-2021 : 15 € gagnés pour 100 € risqués avant, 20 € après, surtout grâce aux deux règles ajoutées.
Pire semaine : -13 mises avant, -17 après. Et ce sont les années qui ont servi à bâtir les règles : c'est optimiste.
En 2022-2025 les règles font 8 € pour 100 € risqués ; il en faudrait 35 pour doubler en un mois : on en reste loin.
Prochaine étape : un seul test sur 2022-2025, déclaré d'avance, avant toute décision.
caveats: In sample only (entries before 2022, frames cut while read) and optimistic by construction: every figure comes from the years that built the rules, and the kept changes were selected from 330 (context) + 29 (cluster) + 126 (breadth) lens trials. No 2022+ row was read; the validation look is declared, not run.

The portfolio's in-sample gain (P0 -> P2: +0.152 -> +0.198 R per trade) comes mostly from adding the two orb crypto sleeves, i.e. more trades of a rule that was strong in 2018-2019, not from better trades of the ten: K1 alone moves the ten from +0.152 to +0.157 R per trade. On 2020-2021 alone the mean / sd of R per trade is 0.107 without and 0.106 with the changes.
K1 rests on its 2021 fold, which skips only because 2018 is in the expanding training window; once the context lens's search is counted, no null test puts it below 5 %.

The orb crypto sleeves: edge per trade halved between 2018-2019 and 2020-2021 (bitcoin about zero in 2021); 72-83 % of their R comes from positions held over the weekend, which the current hands close on Friday 23:50 server; ethusd would carry three sleeves and btcusd four for two positions per symbol (30 and 27 entries refused in the verifiers' runs); orb btcusd was not tradable at the 2018-2020 quoted spreads (+0.05 R per trade there); the two pairs are largely the same bet (weekly correlation 0.40) and correlate with the existing crypto sleeves; the ethusd FP spread is marked uncertain.

Ideal constant-stake account: 1 R per trade, no compounding, no minimum lot, no cap on simultaneous positions (the cluster lens's caps 6 / 2 remove 329 trades, -4.7 R, from the ten). The worst week grows from -12.5 to -16.9 R and the drawdown from 29.1 to 32.1 R because there are more trades; per unit of swing (weekly mean / sd 0.40 -> 0.46) it is better, in sample.

One trade per new sleeve still open at the end of 2021 is excluded (the lens counted it): 344 instead of 345 trades on ethusd, 375 instead of 376 on btcusd (-0.5 and -0.3 R); the gold donch4h and orb trades entered on 2021-12-31 are excluded the same way.

The statements about holding winners longer quote the payoff lens's in-sample table before its attacks; those candidates (and the path and entry lenses) are judged in the other synthesis. If it keeps a change for brk72_24h_wd ethusd, at most one change may go forward on that sleeve.

The FP frames' spread uses a day-median shape that is not causal; K1's descriptor does not use the spread, but its training labels and every simulated fill do (the verifier bounds the effect at about 0.03 R for wide stops).
The F1 sleeves' in-sample results are inflated (their scorecard was fitted on these years); this flatters P0 and P2 alike.

Trials of this synthesis: 9 declared variant lines (R0, C1, N1, N2, I3, P0-P3), each in FP and x1.5, plus 2 truncation tests and 1 descriptive anatomy; nothing tuned. One change to the declaration before it ran (two provisional bars in T1), recorded in declared_addendum.json.
During this session another job (track stake, growth paths) appended lines to results/val_access.log; none of them comes from this synthesis, whose code never calls a validation cut.
